title: GLP-1 'microdosing': ClinicalTrials.gov hand review, label dosing scan and PubMed count
method: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 pulled 2026-10-20 04:09 ET: every study listing semaglutide, tirzepatide or liraglutide as an intervention plus free-text pulls pairing GLP-1 names with microdose, low-dose, taper, interval and maintenance-dose words (1708 unique records). 240 records used dose-lowering language in title, summary, arms or interventions; each was read by hand. Kept: studies that deliberately give a GLP-1 drug below its usual dose or schedule (named microdosing, longer intervals, click dosing, step-down or taper, or a fixed 'low dose'). Dropped: normal escalation schedules, permission to lower a dose for side effects, and low doses of other drugs. SURMOUNT-MAINTAIN was added by hand because its registry text does not use dose-lowering words.
